description: Source file implementing font rendering utilities and text layout logic for the Android Open Source Project's TEE UI framework, including functions for glyph metrics, text wrapping, and rendering.

classes.name: TextFace
classes.description: Represents a font face used for rendering glyphs, including sizing and glyph retrieval methods.

classes.name: TextContext
classes.description: Manages the context for text rendering, including font library initialization.

methods.name: bool isBreakable(unsigned long codePoint)
methods.description: Determines whether a Unicode code point is a line-breaking character.

methods.name: bool isNewline(unsigned long codePoint)
methods.description: Checks if the given code point is a newline character.

methods.name: TextFace::setCharSize
methods.description: Sets the character size in points for the font face.

methods.name: TextFace::setCharSizeInPix
methods.description: Sets the character size in pixels for the font face.

methods.name: TextFace::getCharIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the glyph index for a given Unicode code point.

methods.name: TextFace::loadGlyph
methods.description: Loads a glyph into the font face based on the glyph index.

methods.name: TextFace::renderGlyph
methods.description: Renders the currently loaded glyph into a bitmap.

methods.name: TextFace::advance
methods.description: Returns the horizontal and vertical advance of the glyph.

methods.name: TextFace::kern
methods.description: Calculates kerning offset between the current glyph and a previous glyph.

methods.name: TextFace::getGlyphBBox
methods.description: Retrieves the bounding box of the currently loaded glyph.

methods.name: TextContext::create
methods.description: Initializes a new text rendering context with a FreeType library instance.
